subScenes.name: 提出退房
subScenes.description: 客人向前台礼貌表达退房意愿。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台确认退房时间

followUps.text: Yes, I’d like to check out now.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我现在就退房。

followUps.text: Actually, can I extend my stay until tomorrow?
followUps.text_cn: 其实，我可以延到明天再退房吗？

followUps.text: Not yet—I’m waiting for my roommate to finish packing.
followUps.text_cn: 还没，我在等室友收拾完行李。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应前台对退房时间的确认，体现不同时间安排和需求

qaPairs.triggerText: How would you like to settle your bill?

followUps.text: I’ll pay with my credit card.
followUps.text_cn: 我用信用卡支付。

followUps.text: Do you accept mobile payment like Alipay?
followUps.text_cn: 你们接受支付宝这样的移动支付吗？

followUps.text: Can I get a receipt first? I need to submit it for reimbursement.
followUps.text_cn: 我能先要一张发票吗？我需要报销。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应结账方式询问，覆盖主流支付方式及报销需求

qaPairs.triggerText: Did you enjoy your stay with us?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您对我们的服务还满意吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 前台进行服务反馈征询

followUps.text: Yes, everything was perfect—thank you!
followUps.text_cn: 是的，一切都很好，谢谢！

followUps.text: It was good, but the Wi-Fi was slow in my room.
followUps.text_cn: 还不错，但我的房间网速有点慢。

followUps.text: I’m not sure—I didn’t use many services.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，因为我没怎么使用其他服务。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应满意度调查，体现真实、自然、有差异的反馈态度

subScenes.name: 核对房费
subScenes.description: 前台确认住宿天数及额外消费明细。

qaPairs.triggerText: Here's your itemized bill for the stay. Does everything look correct?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这是您本次住宿的详细账单，请核对一下是否正确？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店退房时核对房费明细

followUps.text: Yes, everything looks good. I'll pay by credit card.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，都正确，我刷卡支付。

followUps.text: Actually, I think there's a mistake — I didn't use the minibar last night.
followUps.text_cn: 等等，我觉得有错误——我昨晚没用过迷你吧。

followUps.text: Could you please explain the resort fee? I didn't see it when I booked.
followUps.text_cn: 能解释一下度假村附加费吗？我预订时没看到这项。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于退房时核对账单的典型对话，帮助学习者识别常见费用项目并学会礼貌质疑或确认

qaPairs.triggerText: Your total comes to $320, including taxes and the resort fee.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您的总费用是320美元，包含税费和度假村附加费。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店退房时告知最终金额

followUps.text: That's fine, I'll pay with my card.
followUps.text_cn: 没问题，我刷卡支付。

followUps.text: Wait, I had a discount code — can you check if it was applied?
followUps.text_cn: 等等，我有优惠码，能查一下是否已使用吗？

followUps.text: Can I pay in cash instead? I need to split the cost with my roommate.
followUps.text_cn: 我可以付现金吗？我需要和室友分摊费用。

qaPairs.usageNote: 帮助学习者应对金额告知场景，掌握确认、质疑和请求调整的自然表达

qaPairs.triggerText: Did you use any extra services like laundry or room service?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您是否使用了洗衣或客房服务等额外服务？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店退房时询问是否有额外消费

followUps.text: No, I didn't use anything extra.
followUps.text_cn: 没有，我没用任何额外服务。

followUps.text: I ordered room service twice — can you add it to the bill?
followUps.text_cn: 我点了两次客房服务，能加到账单里吗？

followUps.text: I'm not sure — could you check if there's a charge for the late checkout?
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，能查一下延迟退房有没有收费吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 训练学习者应对服务使用情况的询问，掌握诚实回应、主动申报和请求核查的表达方式

subScenes.name: 支付结算
subScenes.description: 客人选择支付方式并完成付款。

qaPairs.triggerText: How would you like to pay?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店退房时的支付结算环节

followUps.text: I'll pay by credit card, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我用信用卡支付，谢谢。

followUps.text: Do you accept cash? I only have USD.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收现金吗？我只有美元。

followUps.text: Can I pay with Apple Pay? My card’s already linked.
followUps.text_cn: 可以用Apple Pay吗？我的卡已经绑好了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是退房时最常遇到的付款方式询问，学习者需掌握多种支付方式的表达。

qaPairs.triggerText: Could you check the final bill one more time?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 能再帮我核对一下最终账单吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 退房时对账单金额有疑问，主动请求复核

followUps.text: Sure, here it is — you were charged for the room and minibar, but not for the late checkout fee since you checked out just 10 minutes past.
followUps.text_cn: 当然，这是账单：您被收取了房费和迷你吧费用，但没有收延迟退房费，因为您只超了10分钟。

followUps.text: Actually, there’s a mistake — you charged me for two nights, but I only stayed one night with a complimentary upgrade.
followUps.text_cn: 其实有个错误——你们收了我两晚的房费，但我只住了一晚，而且是免费升级的。

followUps.text: Let me see... Oh, I see — the breakfast was added by accident. Please remove it.
followUps.text_cn: 让我看看……哦，我明白了——早餐是误加的，请删掉吧。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户主动核对账单是高频行为，尤其在涉及附加费用时，需掌握质疑与确认的自然表达。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any additional charges or taxes to add?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 还有其他附加费用或税费要加吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 退房前确认最终总金额，避免意外收费

followUps.text: No, that’s all — the room, tax, and service fee are included. Your total is $189.50.
followUps.text_cn: 没有了，房费、税和服务费都已包含，总计189.50美元。

followUps.text: Actually, there’s a $25 resort fee that wasn’t mentioned at check-in — it’s standard for this hotel.
followUps.text_cn: 实际上，还有一笔25美元的度假村费用，入住时没提到，这是本酒店的常规收费。

followUps.text: We can waive the resort fee since you’re a loyalty member — I’ll adjust it now.
followUps.text_cn: 因为您是会员，我们可以免除度假村费用，我现在帮您调整。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用户主动确认费用细节是避免纠纷的关键，学习者需理解不同酒店收费政策的表达方式。

subScenes.name: 索要发票
subScenes.description: 客人请求开具住宿发票或收据。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like a receipt for your stay?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店退房时服务员主动询问是否需要发票

followUps.text: Yes, please. I need it for expense reimbursement.
followUps.text_cn: 需要的，我需要报销用。

followUps.text: No, thanks. I don't need it.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，谢谢，我不需要。

followUps.text: Can you email it to me instead? My address is john@example.com.
followUps.text_cn: 能发到我邮箱吗？我的邮箱是 john@example.com。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是退房时最常见的一句询问，用户需根据报销需求或偏好选择回应方式。

qaPairs.triggerText: I can print your receipt right away. What's your name and reservation number?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我可以马上为您打印发票，请提供您的姓名和预订号。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 服务员准备开具发票，需确认用户身份信息

followUps.text: It's Sarah Chen, reservation #789456.
followUps.text_cn: 我是陈莎拉，预订号是789456。

followUps.text: I'm not sure about the number... can you check under 'Smith'?
followUps.text_cn: 我不太记得预订号了，能帮我查一下姓Smith的吗？

followUps.text: Actually, I think I already got one at check-in. Do you have a digital copy?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我入住时已经拿过一张了，你们有电子版吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 服务员需核实身份才能开票，用户可能因记忆模糊或已领取而有不同反应。

qaPairs.triggerText: We can issue a receipt for the room and the breakfast separately. Which one do you need?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我们可以分别为您开具房费和早餐的发票，您需要哪一张？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店提供分项发票，需用户明确需求

followUps.text: Just the room charge, please. Breakfast was personal.
followUps.text_cn: 只要房费就行，早餐是我个人消费的。

followUps.text: I need both. My company requires itemized receipts.
followUps.text_cn: 两张都需要，公司要求明细发票。

followUps.text: Can I get one combined receipt with both listed? It's easier for me.
followUps.text_cn: 能开一张合并的发票，把两项都列上吗？对我更方便。

qaPairs.usageNote: 部分酒店支持分项开票，用户需根据报销政策明确需求，避免后续麻烦。

subScenes.name: 礼貌告别
subScenes.description: 客人感谢服务并道别，前台致谢送行。

qaPairs.triggerText: Did you enjoy your stay with us?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您对我们的住宿还满意吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店退房时，服务员礼貌问候并收集反馈

followUps.text: Yes, everything was perfect! Thank you!
followUps.text_cn: 是的，一切都很好！谢谢！

followUps.text: It was good, but the Wi-Fi was a bit slow.
followUps.text_cn: 还不错，就是Wi-Fi有点慢。

followUps.text: Honestly, I had a rough night. The room was noisy.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话，我昨晚睡得不好，房间太吵了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是酒店退房时服务员常问的反馈问题，用于提升服务。用户回应应自然真实，可表达满意、中性反馈或温和投诉。

qaPairs.triggerText: How would you like to settle your bill?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店退房时，前台确认支付方式

followUps.text: I'll pay with my credit card, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我用信用卡支付，谢谢。

followUps.text: Can I pay in cash? I have some local currency.
followUps.text_cn: 我可以付现金吗？我有当地货币。

followUps.text: Could I add this to my room charge? I haven't settled it yet.
followUps.text_cn: 我能把这笔费用加到房费里吗？我还没结清。

qaPairs.usageNote: 结账是退房核心环节，用户需明确支付方式。回答应简洁、符合真实场景，避免冗长解释。

qaPairs.triggerText: Will you be checking in again soon?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您下次还会再来入住吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店退房时，服务员礼貌告别并尝试建立客户忠诚度

followUps.text: Absolutely! I loved the location and service.
followUps.text_cn: 当然会！我特别喜欢这里的地理位置和服务。

followUps.text: I'm not sure yet—it depends on my work schedule.
followUps.text_cn: 还不确定，要看我的工作安排。

followUps.text: Probably not—I live in another city now.
followUps.text_cn: 可能不会了，我现在住在另一个城市。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是退房环节的礼貌告别话术，用于建立情感连接。用户回应应体现真实态度，避免机械回答‘yes’或‘no’。
